LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RecordCache.label: old record chest
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RecordCache.description: A chest of ration lists and migration records. Once a colonist can reach it, you may decide what to do with it.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GrainBurrow.label: granary hole
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GrainBurrow.description: A small hole near the food stores. Left open, it costs at most one unit of food each day, up to three in total. Use the granary letter to seal or clear it.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RecordPages.label: migration records
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_RecordPages.description: Preserved ration lists and migration records. Some figures were corrected several times. These pages grant no special abilities; keep them or pass them on.
LanguageData.Filth_MouseDisasterPoop.label: Ratkin droppings
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GuanyinTu.label: Guanyin clay
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_GuanyinTu.description: Simply prepared chalky clay. It can temporarily fill the stomach, but cannot replace proper food.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_StaleWetCloth.label: stale wet cloth
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_StaleWetCloth.descrip: An absorbent cloth draped over the body. No one knows how long it has been used. It cools the wearer, and in this heat, staying alive matters more than health.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_DryMudCoating.label: dry hardened mud coating
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_DryMudCoating.descrip: Although it feels terrible against the skin, it at least helps the wearer endure heat.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_ReedShadeWrap.label: reed shade wrap
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_ReedShadeWrap.descrip: A loose wrap woven from dry reeds. It barely counts as clothing, but it keeps the sun off and lets hot air through.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_SoakedBarkWrap.label: soaked bark shade wrap
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_SoakedBarkWrap.descri: Bark strips soaked in water and tied across the body. The smell is awful, but the first hours of heat are easier.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_MudReedMantle.label: mud and reed cooling mantle
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_MudReedMantle.descrip: A heavy mat of mud and reeds. It is ugly, damp, and surprisingly useful under a merciless sun.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_HeavyCoolingMud.label: thick cooling mud shell
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Heat_HeavyCoolingMud.descr: Several layers of dried mud cover the body. It cracks with every movement, but it keeps unbearable heat away.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Cold_ThinHempLayer.label: single hemp warming layer
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Cold_ThinHempLayer.descrip: A thin piece of rough hemp cloth. It is not much, but it is better than bare skin.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Cold_LayeredHempClothes.de: The most primitive hemp cloth, woven layer upon layer. It is ugly, but warm enough.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Cold_StrawBarkQuilt.label: straw and bark quilt
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Cold_StrawBarkQuilt.descri: Dry straw and bark stitched between old cloth. It crackles when the wearer moves, yet holds a little precious warmth.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Cold_PatchedFurCloak.label: patched fur scrap cloak
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Cold_PatchedFurCloak.descr: Scraps of fur sewn into a short cloak. The seams are open and the smell is worse, but wind cannot pass through easily.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Cold_SmokeStiffenedBlanket: A blanket hardened by smoke and grease. It is coarse and dirty, but it keeps the cold away.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_Cold_ThickHideHempWrap.des: Several layers of hide and hemp tied around the body. It restricts no vital movement and holds warmth better than it looks.
